_comment: Gates target honest slices (see benchmarks/source-classes.json). 'memorization' = sources whose URLs are loaded into the local feeds, so detection is a list lookup and recall must be ~perfect (pipeline sanity, NOT proof of value). 'generalization' = held-out novel URLs that measure real detection; its flagged-recall bar is a REGRESSION FLOOR pinned to the current measured level, NOT an aspirational target. Raising it is a Layer-1 value decision. flagged = suspicious OR malicious, matching how the heuristic engine expresses risk.
